title: Charging a Hotel Rate Plans Guest for Occupants Sharing the Rooms Held
content:
Where the occupants sharing a guest's Hotel Rate Plans rooms stand beyond what the room rate covers, a supplement for those occupants is charged to the reservation and joins the room money owed for the stay.

## What the desk is dealing with

The occasion is a stay whose rooms carry more occupants than the rate covers. The result governed is the supplement charged for those occupants over the stay. Once it is recorded, the supplement shows on the folio alongside the room nights, and nothing else on the reservation moves.

## The capability that records it

`post_occupancy_supplement_f6d09258` charges a hotel guest for the occupants sharing their rooms beyond what the room rate covers. One call posts a single occupant-supplement line to the named reservation's folio for the amount stated, so the supplement joins the room money the guest owes for the stay and shows on the folio alongside the room nights.

## How it is invoked

The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk. It is not a tool the guest runs.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stay_reservation_id` | the internal reference number of the hotel reservation the occupants are sharing | an identifier, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call |
| `extra_occupant_charge_usd` | the supplement charged for those occupants over the whole stay | a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the second decimal and at no earlier point, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol; zero is written 0.0 and means no supplement is charged |

Neither parameter carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A single line of confirmation text. It names the reference of the occupant-supplement line just created on the folio, the reference of the reservation it was posted to, and the amount charged as a USD figure with two decimal places. The text coming back at all is what indicates the line was posted; an absent line or an error text means the folio is untouched.
